import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 10, M = 25, S = 1048580, MOD = 1000000007;
    static int n, p[][] = new int[N + 1][N + 1], ma[][] = new int[N + 1][N + 1], bin[] = new int[M + 1], a[] = new int[N + 1], b[] = new int[N + 1], f[] = new int[S], g[] = new int[S], tot, id[] = new int[70], pts[][] = new int[M + 1][N + 1], sta[] = new int[M + 1];
    static boolean vis[] = new boolean[N + 1];

    static int power(int base, int exp) {
        long result = 1;
        long b = base;
        int e = exp;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) result = (result * b) % MOD;
            b = (b * b) % MOD;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return (int) result;
    }

    static void setupVariables(Scanner sc) {
        bin[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 20; i++) bin[i] = bin[i - 1] * 2;
        n = sc.nextInt();
        int inv = power(100, MOD - 2);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                p[i][j] = sc.nextInt();
                p[i][j] = (int) ((long) p[i][j] * inv % MOD);
            }
        }
        while (n < 6) {
            n++;
            p[n][n] = 1;
        }
    }

    static boolean canFormMatch(int x) {
        if (x > 3) return true;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
            if (!vis[i] && ma[a[x]][b[i]]) {
                vis[i] = true;
                if (canFormMatch(x + 1)) return true;
                vis[i] = false;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static void exploreOptions(int x, int y, long prob) {
        if (x > 3) {
            int sum = 0;
            for (int i = 1; i <= tot; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= 3; j++) b[j] = pts[i][j];
                if (canFormMatch(1)) sum += bin[i - 1];
            }
            f[sum] = (int) ((f[sum] + prob) % MOD);
            return;
        }
        ma[a[x]][y] = 0;
        if (y == n) exploreOptions(x + 1, 1, (prob * (long) (100 - p[a[x]][y]) + MOD) % MOD);
        else exploreOptions(x, y + 1, (prob * (long) (100 - p[a[x]][y]) + MOD) % MOD);
        ma[a[x]][y] = 1;
        if (y == n) exploreOptions(x + 1, 1, (prob * p[a[x]][y] + MOD) % MOD);
        else exploreOptions(x, y + 1, (prob * p[a[x]][y] + MOD) % MOD);
    }

    static void generateStateCombinations(int x, int y, int s) {
        if (y == 3) {
            id[s] = ++tot;
            sta[tot] = s;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 3; i++) pts[tot][i] = a[i];
            return;
        }
        if (x > n) return;
        generateStateCombinations(x + 1, y, s);
        a[y + 1] = x;
        generateStateCombinations(x + 1, y + 1, s + bin[x - 1]);
    }

    static void computePrefix() {
        for (int i = 0; i < tot; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < bin[tot]; j++) {
                if ((j & bin[i]) != 0) {
                    g[j] = (g[j] + g[j ^ bin[i]]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        setupVariables(sc);
        generateStateCombinations(1, 0, 0);
        a[1] = 1; a[2] = 2; a[3] = 3;
        exploreOptions(1, 1, 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < bin[tot]; i++) {
            int t = 0;
            for (int j = 1; j <= tot; j++) {
                int rev = id[bin[n] - 1 - sta[j]];
                if ((i & bin[j - 1]) != 0) t += bin[rev - 1];
            }
            g[t] = f[i];
            f[i] = 0;
        }
        a[1] = 4; a[2] = 5; a[3] = 6;
        exploreOptions(1, 1, 1);
        computePrefix();
        long totalResult = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < bin[tot]; i++) {
            totalResult = (totalResult + (long) f[i] * g[bin[tot] - 1 - i]) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println((int)((1 - totalResult + MOD) % MOD));
        sc.close();
    }
}
